en.today: Romantic connections could feel restrictive, darling ram, due to a harsh opposition between Venus and Saturn. If you lack the discipline necessary to see major goals through, the blame shouldn't fall on anyone else. Implement new boundaries to ensure you have enough time and space to pursue the success you crave. Luckily, the Sagittarius Moon steps in to elevate your perspective and companionships, especially if you discuss hopes, dreams, and fears with your closest allies.

Remember that blessings come on their own timeline, and don't talk yourself out of pursuing dreams when you see a way toward them. Luckily, the Sagittarius Moon brings out your fighting spirit, motivating you to push yourself.

en.today: Be mindful of what you take on, dearest Taurus, as Venus and Saturn face off. en.today: You may feel torn by conflict between your friends and a romantic interest, dearest Gemini.
